jūjakabrāhmaṇa: [Jūjaka+brāhmaṇa] (pu) CL=7 A Brahmin named Jūjaka. See original.
jūta: [Ju+ta] (pu,na) CL=7 [Juta+a. Ju gati javanesu, to, dīghādi, jūtaṃ.juta dīttiyaṃ vā, karaṇe a. Dhāna,ṭī.531. Atha vā jutheyye, javati theyyaṃ karoti ete nāti jūtaṃ, jūtakiccaṃ. Sūci. Sī,ṭī,saca,1.362- See also. (dyūta-saṃ)] (1) Gambling dice. (2) Dice.
jūtagīta: [Jūta+gīta] (na) CL=7 Gambling song. The song is sung when they play gambling.
jūtakhalika: [Jūta+khalika] (pu,thī) CL=7 A circle shape wooden plank that is used for gambling (board game).
jūtakāra: [Jūta+kara+ṇa] (pu) CL=7 [Jūtaṃ karotīti jūtakāro, kara karaṇe, ṇo. Sūci.] One who is a gambler.
jūtakīḷana: [Jūta+kīḷana] (na) CL=7 (1) Gambling. (2) A place of gambling. See - Jūtakīḷanakāla.
jūtakīḷanakāla: [Jūtakīḷana+kāla] (pu) CL=7 A period of playing dice (gambling).
jūtakīḷanattha: [Jūtakīḷana+attha] (pu) CL=7 The desire to gamble. A cause that is a desire to play dice (gambling).
jūtakīḷanavelā: [Jūtakīḷana+velā] (thī) CL=7 When he is playing a game (gambling).
jūtakīḷitabhāva: [Jūta+kīḷita+bhāva] (pu) CL=7 As a state of playing that is gambling.
jūtamaṇḍala: [Jūta+maṇḍala] (na) CL=7 A circle shape wooden plank that is used for gambling.
jūtaparājaya: [Jūta+parājaya] (pu) CL=7 (1) Loss (or) defeat from gambling. Defeat game. (2) Defeats playing dice. See - Jūtaparājayāpanna.
jūtaparājayāpanna: [Jūtaparājaya+āpanna] (ti) CL=7 Fallen into a state of the loss from gambling.
jūtaparājita: [Jūta+parājita] (ti) CL=7 One who loses everything from gambling.
jūtaphalaka: [Jūta+phalaka] (na) CL=7 A circular shape wooden plank that is used for gambling.
jūtappamādaṭṭhāna: [Jūta+pamādaṭṭhāna] (na) CL=7 A state of negligence that is gambling. Gambling that is a cause of a state of negligence. See - Jūtappamādaṭṭhānānuyoga.
jūtappamādaṭṭhānabhāva: [Jūtappamādaṭṭhāna+bhāva] (pu) CL=7 Gambling that is a cause of a state of negligence.
jūtappamādaṭṭhānānuyoga: [Jūtappamadaṭṭhāna+anuyoga] (pu) CL=7 Makes an effort to play a game (or) gambling that is a cause of a state of negligence.
jūtappamādaṭṭhānānuyutta: [Jūtappamādaṭṭhāna+anuyutta] (ti) CL=7 One who is making an effort to play a game (or) gambling that is a cause of a state of negligence. See - jūtakāra.
jūtasaddavacanīya: [Jūta+sadda+vacanīya] (ti) CL=7 Jūtasadda (words related to gambling) that should be said. See - Jūtasaddavacanīyatā.
jūtasaddavacanīyatā: [Jūtasaddavacanīya+tā]  CL=8 The state of being indicated by the word Jūta
jūtasālā: [Jūta+sālā] (thī) CL=7 The building (or) small building that is for playing gambling.
jūtavittaka: [Jūta+vittaka] (ti) CL=7 One who delights in playing gambling.
